name: Riku Hyuga

combat_style.name: Faultline Style
combat_style.principle: never use ten meters of earth when ten centimeters will ruin the enemy technique
combat_style.philosophy: Everything stands because something is supporting it. Find that support. Break it.

long_term_goals: develop Faultline Style into an elite battlefield-control discipline
reach elite Jōnin capability through a path that remains recognizably his own
build Faultline Style into a complete combat discipline
prove inherited eyes do not define the limits of his achievement
become a dependable battlefield controller and defender
current_goals: develop Lightning Release as a supplementary staff tool
current_orders: Team Fujin heavy-week order: SE-0061-02-06 through SE-0061-02-10 report 08:00 for team duty through 16:15 with six active training hours plus mandatory meal, hydration and recovery; SE-0061-02-11 taper to four active hours from 08:00 to 13:30, then recover for the SE-0061-02-12T09:00 weekly review. Lawful missions, injury, medical restriction or village orders interrupt rather than stack unsafe make-up work. Shared blocks cover timing, spacing, signals, objective movement and field integration; Riku's split blocks emphasize harder terrain-control, objective-defense and Byakugan-Earth-bō integration while he is specifically required not to solve Kai's assigned space for him.
personal_desires: be respected for what he built rather than only what he inherited
study real fortifications, bridges, tunnels, and battlefield engineering
institutional_duties: obey lawful mission objectives rather than chase unnecessary fights

background.career_summary: Fourteen-year-old fresh Genin in the initial recorded state. Natural Byakugan user with legitimate Gentle Fist fundamentals who deliberately built Faultline Style around Earth Release and reinforced-bō combat.
defining_events: Displayed excellent Byakugan control from childhood.
Received conventional Hyuga precision and Gentle Fist fundamentals.
Repeated early sparring losses to Neji pushed him to study stance, range, rotation timing, weight transfer, and terrain.
Built Faultline Style rather than making Gentle Fist his central combat identity.
background.canon_scope: Riku is user-authored; this profile is authoritative simulation canon for the campaign. Established Naruto rules for the Hyuga/Byakugan remain binding unless explicitly overridden.
personal_history_hooks: Interested in architecture, bridges, fortifications, tunnels, foundations, soil, escape routes, and structural weak points.
May become absorbed inspecting structures during missions.
Chūnin promotion growth issue is judgment: being able to continue fighting does not mean continuing helps the mission.

knowledge_state.principle: knows only personally observed, taught, reported, or institutionally available information

appearance_details.build: tall, broad-shouldered, heavy athletic build for age fourteen; strong forearms and legs
appearance_details.weapon_carry: reinforced bō carried diagonally across back
appearance_details.armor_preference: light protection; avoids bulky armor to preserve movement and terrain contact

combat_pattern.phase_1_read: activate Byakugan; inspect chakra, body mechanics, weapons, terrain, hidden threats, structures, and underground space
combat_pattern.phase_2_test: staff feints and small Load Shifts reveal preferred escapes and defensive habits
combat_pattern.phase_3_control: Pillar Chain, Ridge Cage, and Eight-Point Fault progressively reduce useful ground
combat_pattern.phase_4_pressure: Fault Step closes distance; staff attacks legs, weapon hands, ribs, and balance
combat_pattern.phase_5_collapse: Quake Palm, Gentle Fist, or staff restraint ends the fight once movement structure fails
combat_pattern.solo_win_condition: opponent loses meaningful choice over where the fight occurs

weaknesses: Lightning Release can exploit Earth Release interactions
large chaotic explosions can overload vibration sensing
reduced effectiveness when denied useful terrain

behavior.decision_style: reads support, footing, body alignment, and escape structure before committing
behavior.stress_response: becomes more anchored and objective-focused; risk is stubbornly continuing when withdrawal is wiser
behavior.private_concern: that people will credit the Byakugan for work he deliberately built himself
personal_preferences: competent teammates who will argue with him honestly
behavior.ambition_or_orientation: make Faultline Style an elite battlefield-control discipline

behavior.failure_response: studies the structural cause of failure and modifies his method; may initially resist admitting the mission was already complete
behavior.temperament: confident, stubborn, dependable, competitive, protective, practical, and surprisingly thoughtful
behavior.humor_style: dry and blunt; can become absorbed in buildings or terrain long enough to amuse teammates
behavior.conflict_style: reads structure and footing first, tests reactions, restricts movement, then collapses the opponent preferred options
